research_rationale: The complete original creates an indefinite Council of eight federal officers and gives it continuing advice/coordination duties and Treasury support. The full FACA statute section3(2) excludes this wholly federal Council, so section14 supplies no two-year termination. Public Law96-88 section509 carries the HEW reference forward to HHS effectiveMay4,1980 under EO12212; section301 transfers educational functions, not this general Bank advisory role. This is continuity rather than an earlier first end. The Bank Act independently establishes the Bank; its continuing life and the distinct2018 task force are not surviving Council commands. Actual page images confirm the complete original and actual August17,1982 revoker. The located numeric and named-body sources disclose no earlier cessation; EO12379 section15 supplies each first end and the whole-order end. None after the specified bounded savings search. Provisional no is unchanged. This is a proposed producer finding awaiting independent review and mechanical custody verification; not human certification.

savings_residuals.reason: Complete original and revoker, FACA, the Bank Act and relevant Department of Education Organization Act provisions were read. No continuing Council command or Council-specific saving appears. The Bank is separately created by Public Law93-224 section4 and continues until dissolved by Congress; neither its independent functions nor the distinct 2018 Postal Task Force duties are surviving commands of EO11782. Public Law96-88 section509 preserves reference continuity to HHS, and section505 preserves transferred-function orders according to their own terms rather than immunizing this order from later revocation. The bounded named-body/Bank-subject scan and numbered/current-law searches disclosed no revival. This finding does not invalidate historical advice, completed acts or independently sourced rights.
